label: Muscia
svgCode:
<svg xmlns="http://w3.org" viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- Corpo / Sagoma principale -->
  <path d="M 60 160 
           C 60 110, 80 90, 100 90 
           C 120 90, 140 110, 140 160 
           Z" 
        fill="#4b5563" />

  <!-- Coda -->
  <path d="M 135 155 
           C 160 155, 170 120, 165 100 
           C 160 80, 145 85, 150 95 
           C 155 105, 150 140, 135 145 
           Z" 
        fill="#374151" />

  <!-- Testa -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="85" r="35" fill="#4b5563" />

  <!-- Orecchio Sinistro -->
  <polygon points="70,65 65,30 90,55" fill="#4b5563" />
  <polygon points="73,62 70,38 87,54" fill="#f9a8d4" /> <!-- Interno orecchio -->

  <!-- Orecchio Destro -->
  <polygon points="130,65 135,30 110,55" fill="#4b5563" />
  <polygon points="127,62 130,38 113,54" fill="#f9a8d4" /> <!-- Interno orecchio -->

  <!-- Occhi Chiusi / Felici -->
  <path d="M 80 85 Q 87 92 94 85" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <path d="M 106 85 Q 113 92 120 85" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Nasino -->
  <polygon points="97,93 103,93 100,96" fill="#f9a8d4" />

  <!-- Bocca -->
  <path d="M 96 99 Q 100 102 100 99 Q 100 102 104 99" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Baffi -->
  <line x1="70" y1="93" x2="50" y2="91" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <line x1="70" y1="98" x2="48" y2="100" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  
  <line x1="130" y1="93" x2="150" y2="91" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <line x1="130" y1="98" x2="152" y2="100" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Guance Rosa -->
  <circle cx="75" cy="94" r="4" fill="#f9a8d4" opacity="0.6" />
  <circle cx="125" cy="94" r="4" fill="#f9a8d4" opacity="0.6" />

  <!-- Fiocchetto Rosa -->
  <g transform="translate(115, 105) rotate(-15)">
    <polygon points="0,0 -12,-8 -12,8" fill="#ec4899" />
    <polygon points="0,0 12,-8 12,8" fill="#ec4899" />
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3.5" fill="#f472b6" />
  </g>
</svg>
